items.title: Quick access to canvases
items.summary: Canvases are reachable without the big Open window. The + menu has an Open submenu, the Canvas page pill has a switcher, the left rail has a new order with matching Ctrl+number keys, and canvas controls moved into the canvas.

features.name: Plus menu with Open submenu
features.what: Before: Open in the + menu always opened a big search window. Now: pointing at Open shows the 8 most recent canvases and Search all.... Clicking Open itself still opens the original window.
features.how: Click +, then hover Open (or press Right Arrow on it). Pick a canvas, or use Up/Down, Enter, Left and Esc.

features.name: Canvas switcher on the page pill
features.what: Before: the floating Canvas page pill only showed the name. Now: a small chevron next to the name opens one Canvases list: canvases open in tabs (dot, current one checked), then other recent canvases of the project, then Open.... Picking one shows it in the same tab and pane, with no jump to another tab.
features.how: Click the name or chevron on the Canvas page pill (top left of a canvas, shown while its left panel is closed), then choose a canvas.

features.name: Left rail order and Ctrl+number keys
features.what: Before: the left rail order was Chat, Docs, Design, Issues, Agents. Now: Design sits second (Chat, Design, Docs, Issues, Agents) and the number hints and Ctrl+1...9 follow what you see on screen. Tab inside the rail follows the same order.
features.how: Hold Ctrl to see the numbers, then press Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+5.

features.name: Right sidebar toggle inside the canvas
features.what: Before: the right sidebar toggle lived in the title bar and next to the zoom/Share toolbar. Now (pen.dev style): while the panel is open the toggle is at the end of the panel's tab row; while it is closed a small pill with the canvas name and the toggle floats under the zoom/Share toolbar. The Pop out canvas button (four arrows) is hidden.
features.how: Click the toggle in the canvas. It presses the app's own hidden toggle.

features.name: Row actions in the switcher
features.what: Before: canvases could not be renamed or deleted from a quick list. Now: each row shows a ... button on hover with Open in new tab, Rename... (inline, Enter saves, Esc cancels) and Delete... (asks for confirmation first). They use the app's own handlers.
features.how: Hover a row in the switcher, click the ... button, and choose an action.

items.title: Canvas setup starts by itself
items.summary: When a workspace shows the Set up canvases empty state, the mod presses the app's own setup button once and sends the setup prompt, then shows a short toast.

features.name: Auto-start of canvas setup
features.what: Before: you had to click Set up canvases, then press Send in the new chat. Now: after about 0.8 seconds on that screen the mod clicks the button for you, opens the new chat and (by default) sends the setup prompt. It runs once per workspace and shows a toast that says why a chat opened. This starts one AI agent run. Turn off with localStorage re-tempo:canvas-autosetup-off=1, or stop only the sending with re-tempo:canvas-autosetup-send=0.
features.how: Automatic. Open the Design home of a workspace with no canvases.

items.title: Paste image at the pointer
items.summary: Pasting an image on a canvas puts its top-left corner at the mouse pointer, instead of a far-away default spot.

features.name: Image lands at the mouse pointer
features.what: Before: Cmd+V with a screenshot dropped the image at a slot to the right of the other storyboards. Now: it lands exactly under the pointer, using the app's own Paste here code. Text, Tempo elements, Figma, links and pasting into inputs still use the original paste.
features.how: Move the pointer over the canvas where you want the image and press Cmd+V.
